build_ubuntu_teacher: build a Parlai UbuntuTeacher to load single-turn Ubuntu dialog data from CSV with candidate responses
create_multiturn_teacher: create a MultiturnTeacher to load multi-turn Ubuntu dialog conversations and alternate speaker roles
setup_data_ubuntu: run the UbuntuTeacher setup_data method to parse CSV dialog fields and yield context-response pairs
get_multiturn_entry: run the MultiturnTeacher get method to retrieve a specific turn from a multi-turn dialog episode
share_multiturn_data: run the MultiturnTeacher share method to share dialog data across Hogwild training workers
